repo_notes.content: Jekyll theme gem (Ruby >= 3.3) built on Bulma CSS + Alpine.js, offering named layout shells (sidebar-left, sidebar-right, topnav, bare) switchable site-wide via flow.layout or per page via flow_layout front matter.
No Node toolchain: Bulma compiles through Jekyll's own Sass pipeline and Alpine is vendored into the theme.

theme: alone auto-requires runtime deps (jekyll-client-search, jekyll-icon-flow, jekyll-sitemap). Loading the gem as a plugin too (plugins: or :jekyll_plugins group) additionally enables theme hooks — automatic sitemap/noindex exclusion for archived pages and the flow.sitemap switch — plus a config-level sass.quiet_deps default Liquid can't reach.
Every flow.*/icon_flow.*/client_search.* option has a sensible default — the theme renders with zero config beyond theme: and each key overrides individually.
Deliberately no Codecov badge: meaningful coverage is consumer-site/Jekyll behavior rather than a misleading Ruby percentage.
See README.md for the full layout/config reference and release notes.
